raw_answer_text:
```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 flowchart
title "BGP session reset procedure"

process checkcounters "Check interface error counters"
decision errorsfound "Errors found?"
process clearcounters "Clear interface counters"
terminator monitor "Monitor session"
terminator escalate "Escalate to operator"

checkcounters -> errorsfound
errorsfound -> clearcounters "yes"
errorsfound -> escalate "no"
clearcounters -> monitor
```

Notes:
- Genre: `flowchart`, which requires `figdown 0.1` (its floor) and is one of the two EXPERIMENTAL constructs dispatchable at `0.1` without moving the declared version — I stated that trade here rather than defaulting silently.
- Node roles map directly to the scenario: `checkcounters` and `clearcounters` are process steps, `errorsfound` is the decision, `monitor` and `escalate` are terminators.
- The two branches out of `errorsfound` carry the "yes"/"no" labels the procedure states; every other edge is unlabeled since the source gives it no condition.
- I did not have `reference/experimental/flowchart.md` in hand for this session, so this uses the most literal reading of the genre-independent skeleton (quoted labels, bare ids, `type id "label"` declarations, `a -> b` edges). If the actual flowchart reference spells node types or edges differently, run `build-svg.js` and apply any `Line N:` error messages — they name the correct replacement spelling directly, per "retired spellings are hard errors."
